device: LG Fx0 (MSM8926), Venus HFI 1xx firmware VIDEO.VE.1.6-00005 (Jan 2014)
method: r13 RAM candidate with a consistent diagnostic venus-core/dec/enc set in the module overlay (out-of-tree taint only)
findings: stock flow: firmware rejects CONTINUE_DATA_TRANSFER / UNCOMPRESSED_FORMAT_SELECT / BUFFER_ALLOC_MODE when resent after the first sequence event, then crashes (SFR IP 0x9fec)
firmware returns decoded pictures without timestamps; earliest-pending-input fallback restores them; input completions must not consume the table
with continue-data-transfer the firmware faults when it decodes a picture before any capture buffer exists (stock FFmpeg waits for the source change first)
shrinking/re-registering the internal scratch after the sequence event crashes the firmware; keeping a sufficient scratch avoids it
HFI_CMD_SESSION_CONTINUE is fatal on this firmware (VenusHostDriver.c:1980); continue-data-transfer off stalls
capture-first emulation (report negotiated geometry at OUTPUT streamon, hold coded input until CAPTURE streams, ignore the confirming event) works
